title: Improving the 32-bit AES Super-S-box affine approximation
summary: A size-60 affine approximation is known for the zero-key 32-bit AES Super-S-box, while improving it or obtaining a stronger result remains open.

formal_statement.body: For the 32-bit AES Super-S-box with the zero key, a simplified variant of the Greedy-Reduction algorithm produced an affine approximation of size 60; the unresolved task is to improve the size of this approximation or otherwise obtain a stronger result for this same instance.

scope.domain: Symmetric cryptanalysis of S-boxes using automated affine linearization.
parameters: 32-bit AES Super-S-box with the zero key (target instance)
Simplified variant of the Greedy-Reduction algorithm (method used for the baseline)
scope.unresolved_remainder: Improve the size-60 affine approximation or otherwise obtain a stronger result for the same 32-bit AES Super-S-box instance.

citations.label: Algorithmic Toolkit for Linearization of S-boxes

progress.summary: The source reports that a simplified variant of Greedy-Reduction obtained an affine approximation of size 60 for this zero-key instance. It explicitly leaves improving this difficult case as a challenge.
citation_labels: Alex Biryukov et al., Algorithmic Toolkit for Linearization of S-boxes
